analysis.insight_summary: Users are working with a logic controller and an HMI panel to set up alarm notifications. The main source of confusion is linking alarms from the controller to the HMI, specifically regarding variable addressing. Visual aids and peer guidance are crucial for users to resolve issues related to memory address configuration in alarm setup.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want a simple and effective way to configure alarm bits in the controller for visualization and management on the HMI panel. They expect clear variable mapping and immediate feedback to help diagnose setup problems.
